title: Games of Atreus with Heracles
summary: The games of Atreus at which Heracles competed, the first recorded Olympic-type games.
description: The games of Atreus at which Heracles competed, the first recorded Olympic-type games. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 3 (Table 2, row 1221, p. 46).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 3): 1221 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 3: The Founding Dates of Tyre and Carthage," OSF preprint v1.2 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9V65S, Table 2, row 1221, p. 46
chronologies.note: The first recorded Olympic-type games; Heracles died soon after.
